title: UNIT 7 – BEFORE YOU READ – READ – COMPREHENSION
rawTitle: UNIT 7 – BEFORE YOU READ – READ – COMPREHENSION

items.scene: When we add things, we join them together. When we subtract things, we take them away from other things. Then we can see how many things are left. Subtracting in groups. When we count backward, we're subtracting one each time. Count backward from 50 to one. Now count backward by fives, subtracting five each time. Now count backward by tens. How much are you subtracting each time now? Subtraction math problems. All subtraction math problems have a minus sign. This is the minus sign. The minus sign tells us to subtract four from nine. This is the answer. It tells how many are left. Subtraction math problems in rows and columns. We usually write subtraction math problems for single digit numbers in a row. And we usually write subtraction problems for double digit numbers in a column. Subtraction word problems. Let's use subtraction to solve these problems. Alma bought five cookies. Her friends ate three. How many cookies were left? Olivia had 35 grapes. She gave 20 grapes to her little sister. How many grapes were left? Now think of some things that people subtract every day.
